subject: [RFC PATCH v2 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the impact of this change on certain workloads, specifically temporary increased memory consumption and potential slowdowns. Requested additional information about why stealing was removed in 2007.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided additional context about the history of splice operations and the motivations behind this change. Asked for feedback from other reviewers.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to remove the ability for splice operations to 'steal' page cache folios, instead forcing them to copy the data. This change is motivated by a desire to simplify the code and avoid potential issues with folio refcounting.
